Use case: illustration. Asset type: single full-page landscape illustration for a refined children's Chinese classical literature picture book, The Oil Seller (卖油翁) by Ouyang Xiu. Landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, 1536x1024 or higher. Authentic traditional Chinese ink-and-wash and delicate figure brush painting on warm ivory xuan rice paper, lightly feathered ink, dry-brush texture, soft sage green, warm ochre, tiny muted vermilion accents, subtle hand-painted faces, elegantly spare background. Museum-quality Chinese picture-book art, not cartoon, not photoreal, not 3D. Rural Northern Song courtyard, low pale plaster wall, bamboo, gray tiles, soft distant mountains where appropriate. Maintain character designs: Chen Yaozi, a middle-aged man with short black moustache and neat short beard, wearing a dark muted pine-green round-collar robe, black belt and simple black Song-era cloth cap; the oil seller, a slender elderly man with short white beard, gentle lined face, small charcoal cloth cap, worn warm gray-beige cross-collar robe with sage cuffs and cloth shoes. Oil seller's props: bamboo carrying pole, a pair of brown ceramic oil jars, an unpainted natural tan gourd flask, a plain round bronze coin with a SQUARE central hole, a wooden ladle. No modern objects, no modern archery target, no fantasy costumes, no text, no calligraphy, no signatures, no seals, no captions, no borders, no multi-panel collage.
Scene 01: Chen practicing archery in his spacious quiet courtyard. Chen on the right in three-quarter view has just released an arrow toward a traditional woven straw target set safely far to the left, against an empty wall. A few arrows visibly stick in the straw target near its red center spot; don't try to count exactly ten arrows. His pose is skilled, poised and subtly proud, holding a traditional wooden recurve bow naturally. No one standing in the line of fire. The oil seller has not entered the image. Bamboo behind a pale low garden wall, distant misty hill. Wide composition, subtle ink atmosphere, human figure of moderate size, delicate garden details.
